The sources indicate that the ItsDangerous library has dropped support for Python 3.7 and now uses modern packaging metadata with `pyproject.toml` instead of `setup.cfg`. It also uses `flit_core` instead of `setuptools` as the build backend. The `__version__` attribute has been deprecated in favor of feature detection or `importlib.metadata.version("itsdangerous")`. The `Serializer` class now supports generic type checking, and the default `hashlib.sha1` may not be available in FIPS builds. The library is still available at runtime on Python < 3.13.
